title: Sit comfortably
summary: Support the guitar so your hands can move freely.

steps.title: Sit comfortably
steps.body:
Sit on a stable chair with both feet supported. Keep your back comfortably tall and shoulders loose. Rest the body on a thigh; let your arm support it gently. A strap can help. Angle the neck slightly upward so you can reach without twisting your wrist. Left-handed players can mirror this setup.

**Why it matters:** A supported guitar frees both hands. Stop and reposition if anything hurts.

steps.title: Look and listen
steps.body: Hold the body close enough to reach it without hunching. Your hands should not have to squeeze the neck to keep the guitar from falling.

items.prompt: What should support the guitar while you sit?
choices: your thigh and a gentle supporting arm
items.answer: your thigh and a gentle supporting arm

steps.title: Take your time
steps.body: Put both hands in your lap briefly while the guitar is safely supported. Then bring them back gently. Use the screen if you do not have a guitar.
